run_protoc_main: run the protocol buffer compiler with a list of command line arguments via main()
compile_proto_files: compile .proto files to Python code by invoking main with protoc arguments
run_protoc_cli: run protoc as a CLI entry point that auto-adds the grpc_tools proto include path
review_main_function: review the main function that encodes arguments and delegates to _protoc_compiler.run_main
summarize_protoc_module: summarize the protoc module which wraps _protoc_compiler for protocol buffer compilation
